notes: The published title is crude ('JizzStruction'), so this page is titled Alex George LS; the post's title is kept in the source citation as published.

Starting cards as posted under 'Startin Jizz (7)': Hidden Base / Systems Will Slip Through Your Fingers (posted 'Hidden Base/Butter Fingers'), the 'Hidden Base' marker (posted 'HB Modifier (Kessel)'), Rendezvous Point, Heading For The Medical Frigate, Do, Or Do Not & Wise Advice, Your Insight Serves You Well and Aim High; they count toward the 60. Several Effects start, so no single starting Effect is set.

Posted 'HB Modifier (Kessel)' dested Kessel: it is the planet system the objective places face down to mark the 'Hidden Base', and the post names Kessel. It is a second Kessel besides the one in the System section, counted as posted.
The Weapons section is headed 'Weapons (3)' and lists only 'X-Wing Laser Cannons' (plural) with no count; it is taken as 3 X-wing Laser Cannon, which makes the section totals 60.
